"The person who agrees with you 80 percent of the time is a friend and an ally -- not a 20 percent traitor." Ronald Reagan famously said,
From Nixon and Rockefeller to Bush and Cheney, from Boehner and McConnell to Graham and Cornyn, and now to something far stranger--the Republican Party has spent the better part of six decades fighting over what it means to be a "real" conservative. For years, the right's internal critics had a handy label for those they viewed as too accommodating to the entrenched Washington order: RINO--Republican In Name Only. It was a pejorative hurled at members who voted with Democrats on spending, sided with the Beltway consensus on foreign wars, or rolled their eyes at grassroots activism. But 2026 has revealed a phenomenon far worse than any RINO. Call them what they are: NERINOs--Not Even Republicans In Name Only.
The term "RINO" had a certain logic to it. George W. Bush entered the White House promising "compassionate conservatism," oversaw an explosion in federal spending, and left office with the conservative base disillusioned. Dick Cheney, after eight years as the embodiment of the GOP hawkish establishment, became a vocal critic of his own party's populist turn. John McCain built an entire career on being the Republican the media loved precisely because he was willing to undermine his own side. Lindsey Graham and John Cornyn perfected the art of talking like conservatives during primary season while legislating like moderates once safely sworn in. These were Republicans who at least started inside the party, campaigned under its banner, and accepted its institutional traditions, even if they consistently disappointed its voters.

Dick Cheney, after eight years as the embodiment of the GOP hawkish establishment, became a vocal critic of his own party's populist turn. John McCain built an entire career on being the Republican the media loved precisely because he was willing to undermine his own side. Lindsey Graham and John Cornyn perfected the art of talking like conservatives during primary season while legislating like moderates once safely sworn in. These were Republicans who at least started inside the party, campaigned under its banner, and accepted its institutional traditions, even if they consistently disappointed its voters. | | ---|---|--- Continue reading this post for free in the Substack app | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Heartland Journal 99 E. | | | An undercover officer had just purchased narcotics from a suspect. As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled.Duran had only moments to react.He didn't reach for his firearm.He didn't use deadly force. **Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him.** The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries.Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison.And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away.[**Will you help Sgt. clean_body: Convicted because of a cooler | | | | | | Dear Fellow American,This officer was just convicted of manslaughter for trying to stop a fleeing criminal with non-lethal force. Sgt. Erik Duran dedicated 15 years of his life to the NYPD.He earned dozens of commendations. He helped take illegal guns off the streets. He put his life on the line to protect his community. Now he's fighting for his own freedom – All because of a split-second decision he made during a drug bust in the Bronx. | | | | | An undercover officer had just purchased narcotics from a suspect. As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled.Duran had only moments to react.He didn't reach for his firearm.He didn't use deadly force. Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him. The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries.Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison.And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away. The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) is standing with Sgt. Duran and helping fund his appeal.But legal battles like this are long, difficult, and incredibly expensive.And while Erik fights for his freedom, his wife and children are left carrying the burden alongside him. They’re not only facing the reality of their husband and father spending the next 9 years in prison.Their own lives have been threatened because of this case. That's why I’m asking for your help today. spent 15 years protecting others. Now he needs people like you standing behind him. you for standing with Sgt. Duran. Sincerely, | | | Jason Johnson, President Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. **NEW POLL SHOWS THAT THE RACE FOR OH-01 IN VIRTUAL TIE**
_Polling shows that the race for Southwest Ohio is near a toss-up_

---
| |

**Cincinnati, OH** — A new poll was conducted by Quantus Insights fielded August 21-24, 2026. The public poll shows that Greg Landsman leads Eric Conroy 47.9 to 44.6, a 3.3-point gap inside the survey’s own margin of error of 4.6 percent with the incumbent below 50 after 2 terms in Congress. The race for Ohio’s 1st Congressional District is in a virtual dead heat with undecided voters breaking to Conroy three to one. This shows that with 10 weeks to go, and the late movement belonging to Conroy, the race is anyone’s to win.
Conroy has the momentum behind him and the ability to flip this seat. Vice President JD Vance came to Cincinnati’s west side last week to campaign with Conroy. Additionally, National Republicans have already committed $5 million to help flip this seat. This investment comes at a time when, according to the survey, 38.3 percent of the district still has no opinion of the Republican nominee. The combined efforts of Conroy for Congress, and National Republicans will drive undecided voters to Conroy’s campaign.
_“The recent poll shows that our campaign is continuing to move in the right direction. Greg Landsman’s radical policies do not align with the values of this district. I will continue to champion common-sense policies that we know will make Cincinnati a better place for families to live and our region to thrive. I look forward to continuing to build on our momentum as we head into the fall”_ \- Eric Conroy
As we head into Labor Day, and the fall campaigning gets underway, it is clear that Eric Conroy has the momentum and national support needed to flip one of the most highly contested races in the country. The Conroy campaign will continue to work everyday to highlight Conroy’s message to voters: to create a more affordable and prosperous Southwest Ohio.
See more from Quantus Insights: [HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/Rs9CalipVnh?e=3f87e575ad&c2id=83ae238fa0f76420f201b2501cd8e566)
**Press Contact:** Collin Wojcik, Campaign Manager [Press@EricConroy.com](mailto:Press@EricConroy.com)

Hi there, friend — it’s Deb. I know you’re busy, so I’ll keep this quick.
**I’m sharing three reasons to chip in to help me become the next Governor of New Mexico._[But if you already know what I’m fighting for — lowering costs, protecting healthcare, strengthening our schools, and stopping Trump’s agenda — what I’m up against, and how impactful your donation can be, especially with my end-of-month deadline just TWO DAYS away, please chip in right now:](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15433?refcode=jtk1259-fr-nd&t=2&akid=12052%2E400544%2EHfjZ2e)_**
| | **[Pitch in $5>>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15433?refcode=jtk1259-fr-nd&amount=5&t=3&akid=12052%2E400544%2EHfjZ2e)**
---
**1\. Fox News has named this seat a top pickup opportunity for Republicans** — which means Trump and Republicans everywhere are watching, ready to spend whatever it takes to flip our state red. With New Mexico’s recent history of switching parties every eight years, they are coming right on schedule to flip this seat!
**2\. The GOP knows that Governors are the first line of defense when the federal government abuses its power.** With the House and Senate majorities up for grabs and the Supreme Court handing Republicans win after win, it has never been more important to have a Democratic Governor leading. I will hold the administration's feet to the fire on any decision they make that will hurt New Mexican families.
**3\. My end-of-month deadline is coming up in just TWO days, and the strength of our grassroots support — today and every day — will determine how much we can organize in the final months before Election Day.**
**_[We’ve got a big $75,000 grassroots goal to hit, and every dollar gets us closer to delivering for New Mexicans. Will you chip in before midnight on Aug. 31 to help us reach this goal and win this November?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15433?refcode=jtk1259-fr-nd&t=4&akid=12052%2E400544%2EHfjZ2e)_**__

| | | | Dear Friend, Will you help me put God back in your town schools? Specifically, I'm asking you to sign the "[**Schools Need a Bible Revival**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)" petition and tell your Governor that the children in your community deserve to hear that: They are wonderfully made in the very image of God. And that God is calling them to love Him above all else. What a country we'd be, if all of America's children had just a little bit of God's Word in their lives - like you did. But in 1963, in a wrongly decided Supreme Court case, the Left ripped the everyday reading of the Bible out of public schools. **And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family.** It is only fitting that during the 250th Anniversary of our independence, we put Biblical lessons BACK into our public schools. **[That's why I'm spearheading a nationwide Bible Revival in public schools and asking you to join me today.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** Your signature on your "[**Schools Need a Bible Revival**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)" petition tells our representatives that you want biblical lessons put back in schools. Your signed "**[Schools Need a Bible Revival](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** " petition is going straight to my friends at **BRAVE FOR GOOD**. **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group behind my "See You at the Library" movement featured on Fox News, that gets conservative Story Hours into public libraries to counter the Left's "Drag Queen Story Hours." **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group that got an historic conservative Story Hour into the Library of Congress last year! And **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group that will get the Biblical values you cherish - and that America was founded upon - **back into public schools this year!** HOW? We've designed a mini-curriculum for America's 250th Anniversary that teaches children about the role of the Bible in our nation's Founding and emphasizes the Founding values that have made our country great. Last year I got into three public schools to reach 1,400 children with biblical lessons. **[With you and BRAVE FOR GOOD behind me, I know we can expand that number to 250,000 children this year in honor of America's 250th Anniversary.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** That's why **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is getting ready for the battle by collecting stacks of petitions. Your signed "**[Schools Need a Bible Revival](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** " petition tells our representatives that the Supreme Court ruling that took the Bible out of schools only specified that the Bible could not be mandatory reading. The 1963 ruling 100% allows for the Bible to be taught in a historical or cultural context! And why wouldn’t it be? In every corner of the world, the Bible is considered one of the greatest books ever written. Of course children should learn about it in your taxpayer-funded schools! But radical educators will try to keep anything to do with the Bible out of our schools and when they do, **BRAVE FOR GOOD** will be ready to counter them with thousands of signed petitions. **[But that means getting your signed "Schools Need a Bible Revival" petition back now. And will you please also consider a tax-deductible petition sponsorship gift of $35 or more?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** Every petition you send digitally must still be delivered, verified, securely collected, and tabulated before it can be presented - and **[your $35 covers those costs for 400 more signers.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) **That means your gift today puts hundreds of new voices on the record before the deadline. Together with **BRAVE FOR GOOD** and patriots like you, we got conservative and patriotic values back into public libraries. _Now we're going to get biblical values back into public schools._ Only God can lead our nation back to His Word. **But you and I are called to do our part too.** Thank you for standing with us. May God bless you,

body:
We have 43 canvasses planned in swing districts and states across the country, in addition to virtual phone banks.
#
Hi there,
**Are you free today? If so, consider joining us for our[Ground Truth Weekend of Action!](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2315?tag_ids=24436%3Futm_source%3Dem20260829-2611&t=1&akid=2611%2E1562180%2EN9sErK)**
We have 43 canvasses planned in swing districts and states across the country, in addition to virtual phone banks that you can participate in from the comfort of your own home.
We’re working toward our goal of having 500,000 substantive conversations with voters before Election Day, and we need your help to get there. We’re at 15,000 conversations so far, and over the next few weeks, this work is going to multiply.
By talking directly with people in the communities that will decide these close races, you can help learn what matters most to voters and gather insights that campaigns can use to be responsive to voters’ needs and smarter with their messaging, targeting, and outreach.
With less than 10 weeks until Election Day, every conversation we have helps build the relationships and organizing power we’ll need to help Democrats flip the House and Senate.
**So if you can, please join us for a Ground Truth canvass or phone bank this weekend. No prior experience is needed—we’ll make sure you’re trained up before you get started!**
**[Sign Up To Canvass](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2315?tag_ids=24436%3Futm_source%3Dem20260829-2611&t=2&akid=2611%2E1562180%2EN9sErK)**
**[Sign Up To Phone Bank](https://act.swingleft.org/go/1692?utm_source=em20260829-2611&t=3&akid=2611%2E1562180%2EN9sErK)**
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20260829-1&t=4&refcode2=2611_1562180_N9sErK&akid=2611%2E1562180%2EN9sErK)

name: Matias, United We Dream
subject: What we launched on a hot August night
body:
Together, we strengthen our communities for a safer and better future. | | | Peter, **** On a hot Wednesday night in the middle of August, UWD community members from across the country joined a block party from their front porch, a patio, a park bench, anywhere they could. On that call, **we launched five teams** — event leads, outreach leads, storytelling, school and community chapters — so that anyone who wants to organize has somewhere concrete to plug in. We put out a public calendar of community calls and trainings running from September through January, so nobody has to wonder when the next one is. And we introduced people to the organizer who covers their region by name. **[None of this infrastructure is free. Facilitators, interpretation, training curriculum, toolkits that go out to a chapter leader in Connecticut and an outreach lead in Idaho — that's what your donation helps build. Chip in $10 or more today to help us keep that door open.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeIGjw8YzSH_UAUmMq7WLV0krCNSeQgLJ3AAolc0INa2eEoZh7UZ6aIJfquYSmd-trHtTy817GMyteOzsmWM4z-yc12KofG-i75qQxlmM3ep3RzegbR5yZXwt2nyrrTs8rLP4gWgFflVFvzu3iLMdtdhIOjA-Y_SEIBS1IYzw30GnYPA1xH7zbaTYc5T0ardrmTfAbX4ArnXEN1wfUbEsvVvuQgQAIj3ehu-aVfIW046N9JUAFy0172vt-7bx2NHWlF8exoAkWZatJyILMpDeIOXFFNKeNXRjW6P3FW_16-IGorVu4jQrxa_2g89Vsq-roLs2sX_OH2fpROywHhwpTW-eOa66LK74HappqH_9jEQDjBbNUXBb9VWzjCZv20tUGt9HbFjX881C9bssvmvyuRuLK5srwqnlKoTf7_z70EM2UWEoHXa6ivzDTEOZsOhHtsJxyYnONLLGbkaGhs_Dkrw/4tl/c6w6pGMsRgatoTArHew5wQ/h0/h001.0NBTFwFwfJcTu-u-5NNWk58OFPw3T0gxhpjqFH_e0N0)** We started the August block party where we always start: with our story. Young people in 2007 who were given a coat room instead of a seat at the table, and who decided to build their own. _Five years later, that decision became DACA — the first major immigration policy win in over 25 years._ **Our power has always come from community.** When working people organize as a collective, we build the strength to protect our rights, change our conditions, and build the futures our communities need. That's how we win safety and stability for all of us. The discharge petition to force a House vote on the Dream & Promise Act needs 218 signatures. Getting there takes people in districts making calls, hosting power hours, telling their own stories. That's not a mailing list. That's a base. **[We're still here: organizing, opening doors, and refusing to stay silent. And with every block party, community event, and training, we're making the impossible inevitable. clean_body: Together, we strengthen our communities for a safer and better future. | | | Peter, ** On a hot Wednesday night in the middle of August, UWD community members from across the country joined a block party from their front porch, a patio, a park bench, anywhere they could. On that call, we launched five teams — event leads, outreach leads, storytelling, school and community chapters — so that anyone who wants to organize has somewhere concrete to plug in. We put out a public calendar of community calls and trainings running from September through January, so nobody has to wonder when the next one is. And we introduced people to the organizer who covers their region by name. We started the August block party where we always start: with our story. Young people in 2007 who were given a coat room instead of a seat at the table, and who decided to build their own. Five years later, that decision became DACA — the first major immigration policy win in over 25 years. Our power has always come from community. When working people organize as a collective, we build the strength to protect our rights, change our conditions, and build the futures our communities need. That's how we win safety and stability for all of us. The discharge petition to force a House vote on the Dream & Promise Act needs 218 signatures. Getting there takes people in districts making calls, hosting power hours, telling their own stories. That's not a mailing list. That's a base. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | In solidarity, Matias, United We Dream P.S. Our next community call is September 23rd. — and if you'd rather jump straight in, you can . Follow us on: | | | | |

clean_body: An August survey points to a more difficult environment for Republicans.| | | Peter, The latest numbers from North Carolina’s 13th District contain a warning for Republicans. In 2024, President Trump won NC-13 by 16 points, while Congressman Brad Knott won by 18. But this month’s poll shows a much different landscape heading into 2026: Republicans only outnumber Democrats by eight points. | | | | So, what’s changed? More than one-third of NC-13 voters–36% of the electorate–identify as neither Republican nor Democrat. That means the district’s 2024 results cannot be treated as a guarantee. A significant share of the electorate remains unaffiliated, creating a large and potentially decisive group of voters both parties will compete to persuade. These voters must hear about Brad Knott’s work and mission to enforce the law, secure the border, and protect North Carolina families—before Democrats spend millions trying to define him and reshape the race. | | | | Thank you for your attention and support here. -CamData Team | | Paid for by Brad Knott for Congress Copyright © 2026 Knott for Congress Our mailing address is: Brad Knott for Congress PO Box 97275 Raleigh, NC 27624 If you would like to donate online, please visit our website . There is a peculiar phenomenon in modern intellectual life: the persistence of Karl Marx as a credible figure in economics and social theory. More than three decades have passed since the collapse of the Soviet bloc, an event that ought to have settled the question of socialism in practice. Yet Marx persists. His concepts--surplus value, exploitation, class conflict--remain staples of undergraduate reading lists, newspaper editorials, and political rhetoric. This endurance is all the more remarkable because the theoretical demolition of Marxism was accomplished over a century ago. The Austrian School of economics delivered not merely criticisms but refutations that struck at the logical foundations of the entire Marxian system. That these refutations remain obscure in university curricula and mainstream discourse says less about their intellectual merit than about the ideological preferences of the institutions that shape public opinion.

clean_body: Don’t listen to them. | | | | Everyone doubted us. They didn’t believe that we could win in 2018, but we made history. Right here in Wisconsin, we pulled off a major victory when Democrats, Independents, and even some Republicans came together to help me defeat Scott Walker in 2018. It was the first time in over a decade that a Democrat sat in the Governor’s office, and when we won, we made historic investments in our infrastructure, schools, and economy. But, Derek, believe me when I tell you Tom Tiffany is worse than Scott Walker. If he has his way, all of our progress could be destroyed. Democrats want to invest in Wisconsin; MAGA wants to invest in themselves. That is why I am dedicated to electing David Crowley in November. David is ready to take on Trump and deliver for working families. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. **Democrats in Florida just nominated a self-proclaimed socialist in the biggest Senate special election of 2026.**
_**Her name is Angie Nixon. ** _
She publicly and proudly joined the Democratic Socialists of America during her campaign.
She’s a former “community organizer” who literally runs a bookstore called Cafe Resistance.
She’s endorsed by The Squad and held one of her final rallies with Hamas superfan Rashida Tlaib.
**And she just defeated an incredibly well-funded Democrat with a nearly $17 million war chest** _**by more than ten points after raising less than a million dollars.** _
This is not a fringe candidate who stumbled into a nomination. And the socialist movement gobbling up seats all across the country can no longer be excused as some obscure “wing” of the Democratic Party.
**The heart and soul and energy of the Democrats is now with the socialists, and with the support of President Trump and patriots all across the nation, I’m ready to bury this twisted ideology in Florida.**
You and I love this country. We love freedom, the rule of law, and the belief that hard work and responsibility matter. We do not get up every day and work hard, raise our families and build our communities just to see the evil and failed socialist ideology destroy everything we love.
_**This is the line in the sand.** _

subject: Why I’m supporting Molly Gray
body:
Dear Peter, **After winning the Democratic nomination, I’m proud to support Molly Gray in her re-election as Lt. Governor and hope you will join me.** Many of you know Molly’s story. She was born and raised on a vegetable and dairy farm in South Newbury still run by her family, and is a proud product of our Vermont education system. But what you might not know is that straight out of UVM at 22 years of age, she helped elect me to Congress in 2006 then moved to Washington serving on my Congressional staff. Since then, I’ve watched Molly dedicate her career to fighting for the rights of others and — as a human rights advocate and attorney, an Assistant Attorney General, and our Vermont Lt Governor from 2021 to 2023. But what has impressed me most is what she has done since her term ended. She helped build and lead the [Vermont Afghan Alliance](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138143545/643164400/-1532783214?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NjBiNjdjYi1iOGEzLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xO_aiN-ret6m0VzVjkJZMOAgZVrtxMS87lCDIRhx2pI=&emci=2c4d904e-b8a3-f111-9b33-0022482a9a8d&emdi=760b67cb-b8a3-f111-9b33-0022482a9a8d&ceid=43402276), transforming a grassroots volunteer effort into a statewide organization that has helped approximately 650 Afghan allies establish new lives in Vermont. Through driving lessons, housing assistance, job placement, immigration support, and more, Molly has helped grow Vermont’s workforce while helping us keep our promise to those who risked everything for our government. Molly witnessed the cruelty and inhumanity of the Trump Administration up close, and has been working to hold the line and fight back. When Trump tried to defund the Alliance, Molly raised the funds to keep it going. When ICE wrongfully detained an Afghan man, Molly rallied immigration attorneys and prevented his deportation. When Vermont wrongfully ended SNAP for some Afghans, Molly worked with the legislature, attorneys and the Congressional Delegation to get it reinstated. Rather than remain silent, she has continued to speak out and stand up for Vermont’s values. Molly also became a mom, and has helped care for her mother who battles multiple sclerosis. She has experienced firsthand the pressures facing working families in Vermont from rising costs to a healthcare system in crisis. That is why Molly is running for Lieutenant Governor. She understands what the office can be. She is committed to protecting fundamental rights, supporting working families, and making strategic investments that lower costs for all Vermonters Molly has the experience, determination, and courage to lead during these difficult times. Vermonters deserve a Lieutenant Governor who will not hesitate to speak out, fight for our state, be a reliable partner for me and our Congressional delegation, and hold the line. **I’m all in on supporting Molly and hope you will join us by chipping in today here: [**ht** tps://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-pwmg](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138143546/643164401/-352367368?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NjBiNjdjYi1iOGEzLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xO_aiN-ret6m0VzVjkJZMOAgZVrtxMS87lCDIRhx2pI=)**.

**[If you’re short on time and already with me in the fight, then please consider a contribution split between my campaign and Tim Kaine's Common Ground PAC>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138143397/643163933/2022378323?amount=25&refcode=260829em_mrw_tworeasons&refcode2=260829em_mrw_tworeasons&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDQvMS84ODkyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODNiNzEzNC1iOGEzLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CAe9r1_3vvKtANgghJHq2lrw8WF27fewngNUwKypE7s=)**_

**I first ran for public office for two reasons. First, because I believe that every Virginian – and every American – should have the same shot at success that I had.**

I grew up in a middle class family, went to public school, and was the first in my family to graduate from college.

I then tried to get into business, and failed in about six weeks. My next attempt failed in six months. I was incredibly fortunate that my third venture broke through, and that I continued to see success throughout my career in the telecommunications industry.

Success should _never_ depend on where you were born, who your parents are, or whether you had the right connections.

**Second, I got into politics because I believe you shouldn’t have to leave your hometown to find a world class job.** Success cannot depend on luck or geography. You should be able to build a good life in any zip code in Virginia.

It all comes down to this: Where you start should never determine where you end up. And it’s not lost on me – we’ve got a lot more work to do to make that a reality.

That’s why I’m asking Virginians to re-hire me one last time – and elect Democrats up and down the ballot who will stand up to this administration’s actions that are raising costs, fight for our communities, and offer a better path forward for our country.

clean_body: | | | | | | | Derek, this is a longer email than I normally send, but it’s deeply personal to me. I know I ask for your support often, and you deserve to know why I’m asking Virginians to re-hire me, and why I decided to run for office in the first place. = I first ran for public office for two reasons. First, because I believe that every Virginian – and every American – should have the same shot at success that I had. I grew up in a middle class family, went to public school, and was the first in my family to graduate from college. I then tried to get into business, and failed in about six weeks. My next attempt failed in six months. I was incredibly fortunate that my third venture broke through, and that I continued to see success throughout my career in the telecommunications industry. Success should never depend on where you were born, who your parents are, or whether you had the right connections. Second, I got into politics because I believe you shouldn’t have to leave your hometown to find a world class job. Success cannot depend on luck or geography. You should be able to build a good life in any zip code in Virginia. It all comes down to this: Where you start should never determine where you end up. And it’s not lost on me – we’ve got a lot more work to do to make that a reality. That’s why I’m asking Virginians to re-hire me one last time – and elect Democrats up and down the ballot who will stand up to this administration’s actions that are raising costs, fight for our communities, and offer a better path forward for our country. = If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = = = = We’ve got 66 days to make it happen. Let’s keep at it.
